Metadata.title: Antonio Nascimento Jr. — Senior Backend Engineer
Metadata.description: Senior Backend Engineer with 7+ years of experience in Java, Spring Boot, event-driven architectures and AWS.

Hero.bio: 7+ years designing scalable, distributed and high-throughput systems with Java, Spring Boot, event-driven architectures and AWS.

About.title: About
About.text: Senior Backend Engineer with 7+ years of experience designing scalable, distributed, and high-throughput systems. Specialized in Java, Spring Boot, event-driven architectures, and AWS cloud environments, delivering resilient enterprise solutions with high code quality and Domain-Driven Design.

items.description: Lead backend engineering initiatives for a high-scale white-label iGaming platform, delivering regulatory compliance engines, fraud prevention workflows, and multi-region market expansion.
highlights: Integrated automated KYC and identity verification providers (Sumsub, Legitimuz) into user registration flows, mitigating automated bot traffic and ensuring seamless onboarding security.
Engineered core responsible gaming modules enforcing strict loss thresholds and session-duration limits, ensuring compliance with federal gaming mandates across white-label tenants.

Developed automated Slack incident alerting and monitoring around batch processing jobs validating government-restricted individuals (SIGAP), drastically reducing triage response times for compliance issues.

items.description: Architected and scaled cloud-native microservices for Itaú's flagship customer loyalty program ("Mais Vantagens"), leveraging modern Java, AWS services, and event-driven data streaming.
highlights: Engineered and maintained 4 mission-critical Java microservices to orchestrate customer loyalty rewards, scaling the platform to over 100k active users within one year while processing 500k+ monthly benefit distributions.
Designed robust event-driven workflows utilizing Apache Kafka, AWS SQS, and API Gateway on AWS ECS, ensuring sub-second response times and high fault tolerance across distributed services.

Implemented a polyglot persistence strategy using AWS DynamoDB for low-latency operational state retrieval and AWS RDS for relational transactional consistency, paired with AWS Glue ETL jobs for analytical reporting.
Established comprehensive observability and proactive tracing using Datadog, optimizing system bottlenecks, maintaining SLA adherence, and driving operational resilience.

items.description: Led end-to-end engineering initiatives for core digital identity and onboarding products (Unico People, Unico Sign), architecting scalable microservices.
highlights: Led the modernization of the document analysis engine, migrating legacy Angular 5 on GKE to a high-performance architecture, boosting system throughput by 35% and unlocking R$950k in new annual recurring revenue (ARR) via premium tier segregation.

Architected from scratch "mysign", a tamper-proof digital signature management platform capturing critical forensic audit trails, including facial biometrics and geolocation metadata to ensure document authenticity.
Automated bank account verification workflows using Transfeera micro-deposits, eliminating payment failure incidents, reducing support tickets, and ensuring zero-touch recipient account validation.
Engineered automated proof-of-address verification pipelines for candidate onboarding, eliminating manual data entry, accelerating approval rates, and cutting operational review overhead.
Conducted technical and behavioral interview loops resulting in 6 successful engineering hires, while mentoring peers and earning multiple annual Quality and Merit Recognition awards.

items.description: Engineered digital onboarding platforms and modernized mission-critical ATM banking infrastructure.
highlights: Core engineer on the flagship digital onboarding platform ("Abra Sua Conta"), scaling the solution to exceed 3+ million new customer account openings.

Modernized legacy ATM architecture by migrating mission-critical mainframe COBOL systems to a robust Java 11 microservices and Angular stack, significantly lowering maintenance overhead and boosting transaction speed.
Integrated APM observability tooling (Dynatrace) and enterprise DB2 relational data workflows to monitor real-time banking transactions and optimize system availability.
Received the standout ATM Engineering Award for exceptional impact and technical contributions to modernizing ATM self-service software.

items.company: ABTRA — Brazilian Association of Terminals and Bonded Warehouses
items.description: Maintained legacy port logistics software and engineered data integration APIs and BI reporting pipelines.
highlights: Engineered RESTful backend APIs in ASP.NET to process and deliver real-time container throughput metrics, origins, and destinations across the Port of Santos.
Built automated ETL workflows and BI reporting pipelines delivering trade statistics, cargo volumes, and bilateral trade indicators directly to port authorities and government agencies.
Maintained and improved mission-critical legacy desktop systems in Visual Basic 6 (VB6), optimizing SQL queries to streamline data retrieval for port logistics.

items.name: Sukiyaki Event Management Platform
items.description: Full-stack event management and real-time ticketing platform handling table reservations and digital media galleries for a cultural festival.
highlights: Architected a high-concurrency seat reservation engine, implementing optimistic/pessimistic locking mechanisms to eliminate race conditions and prevent double-booking during peak traffic.
Built a digital media gallery module enabling automated photo processing, secure upload workflows, and low-latency asset delivery for attendees.

items.name: Confirm Your Presence (RSVP SaaS)
items.description: Modern guest management and RSVP web application designed to streamline wedding attendee confirmations and seating logistics.
highlights: Developed an automated guest confirmation platform supporting real-time RSVP tracking, guest-list status analytics, and automated notification triggers.
Designed an intuitive self-service portal handling dynamic plus-one validations and dietary/attendance data collection with high mobile responsiveness.
